content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain why atoms form chemical bonds
Identify the three main types of chemical bonds
Describe the conditions under which each type of bond forms
Atoms rarely exist on their own in nature - they join together by forming
. Understanding why and how atoms bond is fundamental to chemistry, as it explains the properties of the substances around us.

Explain why atoms form chemical bonds. (2 marks)
State the type of bonding present in each of the following: a) Potassium bromide (KBr) (1 mark) b) Oxygen gas (O₂) (1 mark) c) Iron metal (Fe) (1 mark)
Explain why sodium chloride is an ionic compound while water is a covalent compound. (4 marks)
Describe, in terms of electrons, how an ionic bond forms between magnesium and oxygen. (4 marks)
